title: En Garde Fencing

services.name: HEMA Fencing
services.desc: En Garde Fencing teaches numerous classes in Santa Rosa and throughout Sonoma County. Fencing is a unique and fascinating sport. It is at once physically challenging and mentally engaging. We teach group classes for ages seven and up, and we work hard to make it affordable and fun for all our students. Take a look at our list of classes to see how easy it is to get started, and then come by to try us out! It is not necessary to buy equipment to begin fencing. We provide basic fencing gear at no extra cost as part of your membership to get you started. services.name: Archery Classes
services.desc: We at EGF are pleased to bring the ancient skill of archery to our students and community! Our classes emphasize learning the basics of shooting with simple bows. The focus is on the development of skills and abilities over time with continuous practice. Students of all ages train in a safe, fun environment, and kids learn to develop important life skills in the context of games and light in-class competition. We offer all-levels family classes on Thursdays and Saturdays, meant for ages (7+). We hope you can join us! You can sign up today by calling us or by coming to a class to check things out.
